title.zh: 工艺选择：按职责选轻重，按结构选路线
title.en: Process choice: choose doping strength by function and route by structure

subtitle.zh: 目标分布、实施方法与验收指标对应
subtitle.en: Align target profiles, implementation and acceptance metrics

body.zh: 先明确导电、控场或承压职责，再选择浓度与形成方法。离子注入控制剂量与区域，需处理损伤与沟道效应；图示离子束及浓度—深度分布。
body.en: First establish whether the region conducts, controls fields or withstands voltage; then select concentration and formation method. Implantation controls dose and location but requires treatment of damage and channeling. The diagram shows the ion beam and a concentration–depth profile.

body.zh: 扩散依赖杂质源与热历程，关注横向扩散；图示杂质源、高温与浓度—深度分布。原位掺杂外延在生长中形成掺杂层，控制生长、界面与杂质引入；图示含杂质反应气体、掺杂外延层及浓度—深度分布。
body.en: Diffusion depends on the dopant source and thermal history, with attention to lateral diffusion. Its diagram shows the source, high temperature and depth profile. In-situ doped epitaxy forms the doped layer during growth and requires control of growth, interfaces and dopant incorporation; its diagram shows dopant-containing reactant gas, doped epitaxial layer and depth profile.

body.zh: 区域职责 → 目标剖面 → 路线比较 → 热预算与兼容性 → 试片验证。控制浓度与梯度、深度与位置、热预算和均匀性。
body.en: Regional function → target profile → route comparison → thermal budget and compatibility → test-wafer verification. Control concentration/gradient, depth/location, thermal budget and uniformity.

body.zh: 只追求峰值可能忽略接触区、承压区与结边界。路线不匹配会带来剖面或热预算问题。
body.en: Optimizing only the peak can neglect contact regions, voltage-supporting regions and junction boundaries. A mismatched route causes profile or thermal-budget problems.

body.zh: 通过SIMS进行区域规格验收，并以片电阻和器件测试定位异常。重掺杂常服务低阻区，轻掺杂常服务电场或承压设计；必须结合具体结构，不能互换替代。
body.en: Use SIMS for regional specification acceptance and sheet resistance/device tests to locate anomalies. Heavy doping often serves low-resistance regions; light doping often serves field or voltage-support design. Apply these choices to the specific structure; they are not interchangeable.
